decisions.reason: The source separately specifies homepage video placement, but that effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting homepage_video_placement to beside the portfolio photos.
Placing a video beside homepage portfolio photos does not change the existing requirement that portfolio tiles link to the Gallery page.
Choosing videos alongside pictures implies they are not a separate gallery tab, and that effect is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY removing videos from main_gallery_tabs.
The source determines video placement relative to pictures; it does not alter photo-selection authority, photo-placement authority, or the requested photo assets.
Gallery video placement does not change whether gallery hover animations are enabled on desktop or mobile.
The source places a video beside portfolio photos but does not change the homepage gallery's basic animation behavior.
Video placement on the homepage does not alter the destinations of the Gallery, Pricing, or Services buttons.
The source contains no pricing-table or mobile-layout decision; the overlap comes only from unrelated gallery and portfolio terminology in prior history.
The new video placement does not change the established homepage design direction, image emphasis, blue overlay, or overlay opacity.
Integrating videos alongside pictures remains compatible with the sitewide visual emphasis and does not modify that requirement's current state.
The source does not affect the detailed pricing layout, service coverage, pricing breakdown, or item classification.
Gallery and homepage video placement does not affect the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
